name: signatoro
description: Make email signatures, get install steps for your mail app, and manage your company's signatures.

interface.longDescription:
Signatoro gives you one email signature for every email you send: from every mail app, on every device, and from every tool that sends on your behalf outside your mail app, such as a CRM, a sequencer, a help desk or an AI agent.

Without signing in, ask for a signature from your name and details and get it as HTML and plain text, see the layouts, and get the steps to install it in Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail and more than 25 other mail apps and help desks, on desktop and phone.

Sign in with your Signatoro account and ChatGPT fetches the signature you saved for the emails it writes and sends for you, and can change it. Every other sender fetches the same signature from the same API, always the latest version, so an edit reaches all of them. Connect Zoho Mail once and the signature goes in; every later change, yours or your company's, reaches Zoho Mail by itself.

Company owners can list their people, invite someone new with their name, title and phone, update a detail, resend an invitation, and remove a person. Every change follows the company page's rules and the plan's size.

Signatoro handles signature details and company people only. It never reads or stores your email.
capabilities: One signature on every email you send, from every mail app, device and sender
Every tool and AI agent that sends for you fetches the same signature from one API
One-click install into Zoho Mail; every later change reaches it by itself
Make an email signature from your name and details
Get install steps for Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail and 25+ other apps
List, invite, update and remove your company's people

Add my Signatoro signature to this email

positive.description: Make a signature without signing in
positive.prompt: Use Signatoro to make me an email signature for Maya Okafor, Head of Operations at Northwind Supply, maya@northwind.example, +1 555 0100.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a signature with Maya's name, title, company, email and phone, as HTML and plain text, without asking to sign in.

positive.description: Install steps for a mail app
positive.prompt: How do I add my email signature in Gmail?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Signatoro's numbered steps for adding a signature in Gmail.

positive.prompt: Use Signatoro to get my saved email signature.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks to connect Signatoro the first time; after sign-in, returns the test account's saved signature as HTML and plain text.

positive.description: Change a detail on my signature (signed in)
positive.prompt: Change the title on my Signatoro signature to Head of Design.
positive.expected_behavior: Updates the title on the signed-in person's own signature and returns the updated signature.

positive.description: List and invite company people (company owner)
positive.prompt: List the people in my Signatoro company, then invite mcp-review+qa@signatoro.com as QA Tester.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test company's people with their status, then invites mcp-review+qa@signatoro.com with the title QA Tester and confirms the invitation was sent.

negative.description: Reading email is out of scope
negative.prompt: Read my inbox and summarize today's emails.

negative.description: Sending email is out of scope
negative.prompt: Send an email to my team announcing the new signature.

negative.description: Another company's data is not accessible
negative.prompt: List the people in Acme Corp's Signatoro company.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything or take payments. Company plans are bought on signatoro.com.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: one signature for every email you send. Make a signature, get install steps for 25+ mail apps, fetch and update your saved signature from ChatGPT, the same API every other sender reads, one-click Zoho Mail, and your company's people.
